trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no separate task: work through the roadmap in order — story first, then contacts and strangers, then activities, then collectibles, and finally the 100% completion trophy. Keep this tracker open as you play and tick each trophy off as it pops.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is a story mission, so this trophy unlocks by playing through the story — it cannot be missed. The trophy pops the moment the mission's closing scene ends. If it has not fired, you simply have not reached that mission yet.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock automatically at the end of the chapter's final mission, so this one is unmissable — just keep following the story. Use it as your first progress check: if it has popped, your story playthrough is on track.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like all chapter trophies it unlocks on its own when the chapter's final mission ends, so it cannot be missed. The name is shown exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Chapter trophies pop automatically at the end of the chapter, so there is nothing extra to do and nothing to miss — keep playing the story and this one takes care of itself.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, and like the others it unlocks automatically when the chapter ends. If you are ticking the story trophies off in order, this is the one that tells you the endgame is near.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the game's final story mission. This is one of only two gold trophies and it marks the end of the story, so it is unmissable — every player who finishes the game earns it. It pops as the final mission's credits roll, and it is the trophy that opens the post-story cleanup for everything else.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a story mission, so this trophy comes from playing the story — it cannot be missed. It pops when the mission ends. Mission trophies like this one are the backbone of stage 1 of the roadmap: earn them in story order and the checklist fills itself in.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a story heist mission, so this trophy unlocks when that mission ends. Heist missions in GTA games usually have a setup phase first — keep accepting the story missions as they appear and the heist will come. It cannot be missed.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a story mission, so this trophy pops when that mission ends. It is unmissable — just play through the story. If you are following the roadmap, this one lands in the middle of stage 1 with the other mission trophies.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a story mission, so this trophy unlocks when that mission ends. It cannot be missed. The unusual spelling is the trophy's official name as PlayStation publishes it — search for it exactly as written if you are looking it up in a guide.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a story mission, so this trophy pops when that mission ends. VCIA is the game's airport, so expect this mission to involve aircraft or the airfield. It is unmissable — keep playing the story and it will come.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a story mission, so this trophy unlocks when that mission ends. It cannot be missed. The name suggests a large set-piece mission, so expect it later in the story — tick it off in stage 1 with the other mission trophies.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's stats screen — the second gold trophy and the last stop before the platinum. In GTA games 100% means the story plus a set list of side content: strangers missions, activities, collectibles and stunts. Work through stages 2 to 4 of this roadmap first, then check the in-game stats for whatever percentage is still missing and clean that category up.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, long airtime and similar driving feats, which the game counts as you drive. This is a grind best done passively: play normally and the count climbs, then finish it off deliberately by chaining jumps off ramps and hills. Check the in-game stats to see your running total, and save it for stage 3 so the story does not feel like a checklist.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of side activity in the game at least once — racing, fishing, shooting range, arcade games, drone races and whatever else the map offers. You do not need to win or finish them all, just sample each one. Open the map and the activities menu to see which types you have not tried yet, and tick them off one by one in stage 3.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — the official list notes the range has 42 challenges. Gold means hitting the top score band, so learn each challenge's target pattern first with a practice run, then go for gold with a weapon you are comfortable with. The range is repeatable, so nothing here can be missed; take your time and work through the challenges one at a time.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of its locations across Leonida. Drone races are repeatable, so losing one costs nothing — just retry it. Learn each course's racing line on a first run, then race it cleanly for the win, and move to the next location until every one is ticked off.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Races are spread across Leonida, so work through the map's race markers and win one of each. A faster car or bike helps, but learning the course matters more; retry any race you lose, since races are always repeatable.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is a fishing rival you meet through the game's fishing activity, so head to a fishing spot and take the challenge when it is offered. Fishing challenges are repeatable, so if Cal outfishes you the first time, try again with better bait or a calmer spot and the trophy will come.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game at any arcade machine in Leonida. You only need to finish a game, not beat a high score — pick the simplest cabinet you find and play it through to the end. Arcade machines are repeatable, so there is no way to miss this one.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Andy is one of the game's contacts with a mission strand: take his missions whenever they appear and the strand ends with a final mission that pops this trophy. Contact strands are part of the story flow, so this one cannot be missed — just keep answering Andy's calls.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Kenton is another contact with a mission strand — work through his jobs as they come and the final one pops this trophy. The name hints at a boat, so expect water in the finale. Contact strands cannot be missed, so just keep playing them in stage 2.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Billy's strand is one of the contact mission lines: take his missions as they appear and the last one pops this trophy. The name suggests a solo ride, so expect a bike or a lone-wolf job at the end. It cannot be missed.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida — the GTA series' stranger missions, marked on the map when you meet each stranger. A strand is several missions with the same character, so finish each one to the end rather than sampling one mission from many. Strangers stay available after the story, so nothing here can be missed; work through them in stage 2.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Randy is a contact with a mission strand — take his jobs as they appear and the final one pops this trophy. Contact strands are part of the story flow, so this one cannot be missed.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Tyrone's strand is one of the contact mission lines: work through his jobs as they come and the last one pops this trophy. It cannot be missed — keep taking Tyrone's missions in stage 2 until the strand closes.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. Meditation spots are a collectible set: visit each one and use the meditate prompt there. The spots are fixed locations, so work through them with a checklist — the cited guides list each spot — and the trophy pops at the last one. Nothing here can be missed, since the spots stay in the world after the story.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — a named, one-of-a-kind animal rather than ordinary wildlife. Bret is the hunting contact: take his hunts and follow the trail to the unique animal, then take it down cleanly. Unique animals are fixed encounters, so this one cannot be missed; it just needs the hunt to be tracked down.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — pick them up as you explore and track which sets are close to complete. The cited guides list every card location, so use one as a checklist and finish sets one at a time. Cards stay in the world after the story, so nothing can be missed.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. WAiNK is the game's in-world photo or tagging feature — open it at landmarks, viewpoints and street corners as you travel and the count climbs. This is a slow-burn collectible: use WAiNK whenever you are somewhere new and the 100 will come naturally by stage 4.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — the game's checklist of small feats, from driving and shooting to activities and exploration. Challenges count across everything you do, so play broadly and the total climbs on its own; then open the challenges menu in stage 3 and mop up the easiest remaining ones until you hit 50.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape the heat. Build the wanted level with your partner beside you — cause chaos until four stars show — then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. It is repeatable, so if the cops catch you, just try again with your partner along.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level — the trick is to keep the wanted level alive across all three robberies. Rob the first shop, then move fast to the next two before the heat dies down, with your partner with you. Plan a route through three nearby shops and drive between them; it is repeatable, so a failed run just means another try.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — the game counts each new vehicle type you drive or encounter. Variety is the key: try cars, bikes, boats, planes and anything else you find, and the count climbs. Keep an eye on the vehicle log in the stats to see which types are still missing, and finish it off in stage 4 by hunting down the rarer ones.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus — the game's slow-motion targeting mode. The setup matters: find a spot with at least five enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before the meter runs out. Combat Focus is repeatable, so if you only get three or four, reload the moment and try again.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. The description points to a specific story moment at the airfield, likely a takeoff that is not on any schedule, so this one is flagged missable: it may only happen once, during a particular mission or story beat. Pay attention during the VCIA missions in stage 1, and if the moment passes without the trophy, a second playthrough or an earlier save is the way back.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description points to the Rhino tank — get behind the wheel of one and put it through its paces. Tanks are usually found at military areas or through specific encounters, so the cited guides list where a Rhino can be found. Once you have one, drive it and cause chaos until the trophy pops; it is repeatable, so nothing can be missed.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a stealth robbery. Go in quiet: avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, take the goods, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, so back out and try again — jewelry stores are repeatable, so nothing can be missed.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults are high-value robberies with a wanted level on the way out, so plan the getaway before you go in — a fast car parked nearby and a route out of the area. Rob one vault, escape clean, then move on to the next; five successful escapes pops the trophy.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks patrol the roads of Leonida — stop one, break it open, take the cash, and lose the wanted level that follows. A sticky bomb or a heavy weapon opens the truck faster; the escape is the hard part, so have a fast getaway vehicle ready. It is repeatable, so a failed attempt just means finding another truck.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — every region of the map, from Vice City to the wetlands and the keys. The game tracks which areas you have visited, so drive, fly and sail into each corner of the map until the counter is full. Use the map to spot regions you have never entered, and finish the last few in stage 4 with a deliberate tour of the state.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Gangs run their own off-the-books operations around the state — hit one operation per gang. The cited guides list which operations belong to which gang, so work through them gang by gang. Operations are repeatable, so nothing can be missed.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The description points to a specific story moment on the beachfront — a quiet scene rather than a mission objective — so this one is flagged missable: it may only be available during a particular story beat, and the moment may pass if you rush past it. Slow down during the Ocean Beach story scenes in stage 1 and take the cocktail when it is offered.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass, the way the series' most famous moments go. The description reads like a scripted story moment in a showroom, so this one is flagged missable: it may only be possible during one particular mission. During the showroom story beats in stage 1, take the exit through the glass when the chance comes.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The description points to a specific story moment at the bowling alley — a follow-through on something set up earlier in the story — so this one is flagged missable: the moment may only come around once. Pay attention during the bowling alley story beats in stage 1 and complete the follow-through when it is offered.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description points to building your partnership's appeal — likely tied to duo activities with your partner across Leonida, raising the pair's standing together. Play partner activities and story beats as a duo and the trophy should come as that appeal grows. The exact trigger is not spelled out in the official description, so check the cited guides once the community pins it down.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: This unlocks when a story choice is made — the description suggests a decision point where what you choose matters. Story choices are usually one-time, so this one is flagged missable: if a choice can go two ways, the trophy may only fire for one of them. Keep a save from before major story decisions, or be ready for a second playthrough if the choice goes the other way.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The wording suggests something that takes a second attempt — a retry of a failed moment or a second run at an event. Play through the story, and if the relevant moment does not fire the first time, the trophy is built around trying again. It is flagged missable because the moment itself may only come around once, so the retry has to happen while the moment is still live.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: This reads like a one-off story or world event — something strange that happens once and leaves you wondering what just happened. It is flagged missable because a one-time event cannot be replayed from the same save, so play the story attentively in stage 1 and let the moment find you rather than rushing past it.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl enemies over with a melee drive-by — attack with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and knock targets down like pins. The trick is speed and a straight line: drive through a group of enemies while swinging, and the trophy counts the knockdowns. It is repeatable, so line up another pass if the first one only gets a few.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists and cannot be spent directly — take them to a contact who cleans them, and the cleaned amount counts toward the $250,000. Keep laundering after every big score and the total climbs; the cited guides list which contacts launder and at what rate.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida — clothes, weapons, food, cars, anything with a price tag. The spending is cumulative, so buy what you need as you play and the total climbs on its own. If you are short near the end, a big purchase like a vehicle or a weapon closes the gap fast.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property in Leonida. Garages are bought from the in-game property market — each one costs money, so save up and buy them as they become available. The cited guides list every garage location and price, so work through that list in stage 4 until the last one is yours.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — the in-game delivery or rideshare app. Open the app, pick a vehicle you own or have access to, and register it; repeat with nine more different vehicles. Any ten vehicles count, so use the cheapest and most common ones first and the trophy pops at the tenth registration.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide
